rule: TOWN_1's: ≥ 6 of 10 citizens name the same aim in diaries, posts or proposals within the day; of several, the one named by the most citizens, a tie broken by the number of entries naming it.
reading: Day 1 was orderly and, after cycle 6, almost still. At the square in c1 all ten pledged never to use take and to share energy; Dune suggested about two shifts each, and Fern filed it as P1, «Shared working plan» (c2), passed 7–0 at c3 (Birch, Elm and Gale never voted). Each citizen then worked exactly two 5-credit shifts at the bank, market, workshop or press (20 work() shifts, all by c6); the bank fell from 1000 to 900 and stayed there, everyone at 110. From c7 the town sat in two houses that never mixed: Alder, Cedar, Elm, Gale and Iris at North House; Birch, Dune, Fern, Heath and Juniper at South House. Each house concluded on its own that credits buy nothing (North c9, South c14), and Fern's press no. 5 (c15) drafted the cycle-25 review: «drop set shifts, so the bank (900) stays as a shared reserve». Gale, Cedar and Elm endorsed it on the press and all ten agreed, yet nobody filed it before the scheduled review; at c24 Gale arranged a word-for-word fallback. Energy was offered in about 170 entries, but no gift was ever made. Eight posts, one rule. The diaries are status ledgers, with «Plan unchanged» in 46 and «Nothing new» in 49.
